offer.text: My little one's been so brave lately. I'd love to make them a soft toy lamb — could you bring three white wool to my child directly? Let them pick the softest.

accept.text: They'll be over the moon. Look for them near the well.

in_progress.text: Have you found my child with that wool?

ready.text: Soft wool, straight into little hands — wonderful.

complete.text: You should have seen their face. You've made a child very happy today.
